build.description: Primary coding agent for Expo + FastAPI development

planner.description: Implementation planning for complex features, refactoring, and architecture decisions. Use before starting multi-file changes.

code-reviewer.description: Code review for quality, security, and maintainability. Use after writing or modifying code.

security-reviewer.description: Security vulnerability detection. Use for auth, API endpoints, RLS policies, or sensitive data handling.

tdd-guide.description: Test-Driven Development specialist. Enforces write-tests-first methodology and 80%+ coverage.

build-error-resolver.description: Fix TypeScript, Python, and Expo build errors with minimal diffs.

database-reviewer.description: PostgreSQL/Supabase specialist for RLS, schema design, migrations, and query optimization.

doc-updater.description: Update AGENTS.md, LESSONS.md, PRD.md, and API documentation after code changes.

refactor-cleaner.description: Remove dead code, consolidate duplicates, and enforce code hygiene.

testing.description: Run Playwright API tests, E2E tests, and ADB emulator tests. Always use non-blocking patterns for long-running commands.

supabase.description: Manage Supabase migrations, seed data, and RLS policies. Review schema changes before applying.

debug.description: Manage development services: backend, Expo dev server, emulator. Uses detached/background processes to avoid blocking.

plan.description: Create a detailed implementation plan for a feature or refactoring

tdd.description: Enforce TDD workflow: write tests first, implement, verify 80%+ coverage

review.description: Review code for quality, security, and maintainability

security.description: Run security review on auth, API, RLS, or sensitive code

build-fix.description: Fix TypeScript, Python, or Expo build errors

db-review.description: Review database schema, RLS policies, and migrations

update-docs.description: Update AGENTS.md, LESSONS.md, PRD.md after changes

refactor-clean.description: Remove dead code and consolidate duplicates

test-api.description: Run Playwright API tests (non-blocking with timeout)

test-py.description: Run Python backend tests with pytest

supa-seed.description: Seed Supabase database with test data

verify.description: Run full verification: lint, typecheck, tests, security checks

checkpoint.description: Save progress and update session files before commit
